name: Dinosaurs
overview: Scripture reveals that God created great and diverse creatures, including large and powerful beings such as behemoth and leviathan, which some interpret as references to dinosaur-like creatures or mighty animals (Job 40:15, Job 41:1). These creatures were formed by God to inhabit the earth and waters, demonstrating His sovereign power over all living things (Genesis 1:21, 1:24). The Psalms affirm God's control over these creatures, describing how He can break the heads of leviathan and use it for His purposes (Psalms 74:14, 104:26). Thus, the Bible acknowledges the existence of great creatures as part of God's good creation.
